name: codepulse
description: CodePulse – GitHub Repository Health Monitor. Analyze public GitHub repos, compute 100-point health scores, identify security risks, visualize activity, and get AI recommendations with Groq.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"

author: Magesh Anand
